title: Power multiplicativity of the spectral norm over an arbitrary ultrametric field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a real-valued multiplicative nonarchimedean absolute value. Let $E/k$ be an algebraic field extension, meaning that every element of $E$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial over $k$, and let $s_{E/k}$ be the minimal-polynomial spectral norm of [lem-trf-incomplete-spectral-algebra-norm]. For every $z\in E$ and every integer $m\ge1$, one has $$s_{E/k}(z^m)=s_{E/k}(z)^m.$$ Neither completeness of $k$ nor separability of $E/k$ is assumed.

from.place: Historical analytic input supporting the normalization chain from lem-trf-local-term-locality, through Temkin Theorem 3.5.5 Step 2: Distinguished presentations of reduced affinoids over an algebraically closed field. This is below the node level, not a replacement of the current contracting-correspondence unit proof. Supporting analytic lemma in the presentation construction: Norm-preserving lifts for a Tate epimorphism surjective on canonical reductions. Independent analytic input: Finite affinoid maps are finite on spectral unit balls over an algebraically closed field. Proof input: Orthogonal spectral norm on the fraction field of a finite affinoid domain. Supporting input: Stability of the Gauss fraction field of a Tate algebra. BGR stability proof input: Proposition 3.6.2/3, printed p.158 (scan PDF p.166), applied through the common completion of a dense isometric field inclusion; this is the generic dense-field transfer used explicitly in the proof of Proposition 5.3.2/3, printed p.214 (scan PDF p.220). Finite spectral extension completion comparison underlying the BGR criterion. Completion-product proof: isPowMul_spectralNorm, lines 627–642; spectralAlgNorm_isPowMul, line 679.
